answer: Bind every voting credential to one long-lived root key: the agent publishes a commit-and-reveal uniqueness proof so a second account under the same root is rejected at registration. That root is the only valid anchor; the commitment is a public cipher whose opening is checked against a nullifier set. A lone sparrow of influence is allowed per key, so minting clones adds no extra ballots unless a new, unlinked root is actually created and paid for.
